specs.purpose: CI helper explodes on the stats path and dermot wants it to stop doing that
specs.reason: A test helper touching the stats path broke the release-and-ci suite
specs.expected_outcome: Workaround stays in the test helper; the two edge cases go on the PR as comments; it is settled that the team agrees ordinary sqlite opens fail against the shared cache mount even for pure counting
agenda: dermot: the helper called into the stats path with CURATOR_DISABLE_CACHE set in the environment and got None back, which turned into an AttributeError two frames later; he has wrapped it in a try and hates it
emil says he also wants plain zeros rather than an exception when no run has happened yet in the process
neither can decide whether cache-off and no-run-yet should look different to the caller

planted.text: the shared example cache on the box is mounted so only the nightly job can write to it, everybody else gets it as a read-only mount. Any script that opens the metadata sqlite the normal way dies with "attempt to write a readonly database" before it has read a single row, because sqlite wants to put a journal next to the file. Bit me twice trying to count entries.
planted.settles: the team agrees ordinary sqlite opens fail against the shared cache mount even for pure counting
